title: 第2章 蛮启
content_zh:
（新书急需收藏，推荐，道友们，）

这是一块普通的石头碎片，只有婴儿巴掌大小，样子不规则，其上除了有一些似天然而成的纹络外，还有一个中空的小孔，似一个挂件。

但整体看起来也没有什么出奇的地方，很寻常的样子。

唯一有些奇异的，则是当苏铭拿着碎片时，感觉其上温暖，似有一股暖意流入身体，让人很是舒服。

“咦？”苏铭仔细看去，但看了半响，也没看出什么端倪。

“听阿公提过，据说很早的时候这里曾经是火蛮之地，如此看来，此物说不定具备了一些火蛮之力，所以才会让人感觉温暖，倒也不错。”苏铭解开脖子上挂着的月牙骨圈，将这碎片套入进去后，重新挂在了脖子上，那碎片贴着胸口，暖意更浓了一些。

“回家了！”少年迈开大步，向着远处那一片灯火之地，快速的跑了过去，此刻的他没有注意到，那怀里贴着胸口的石头碎片，有一抹微弱的光芒一闪而逝。

随着临近，在苏铭的眼前，那微弱的灯火渐渐清晰，可以看到那是一处被诸多巨木组建的围墙环绕而成的部落。

范围不大，约莫只有数百人居住的样子，但在苏铭眼中，这里却是让他感觉温馨。隐隐的，还有阵阵热闹的欢声传了出来，可以从那一排排巨木围墙的缝隙内，看到部落的中心处，有一团巨大的篝火，四周有诸多的族人，更有一些部落里的女子，正对篝火起舞。

部落的大门，同样是巨木组成，当打开时，往往是被几根绳索吊起，如今紧闭，其上更有几个身子极为魁梧的大汉，穿着兽皮衣衫，皮肤极为粗糙，脖子上挂着森森白骨串，耳朵上更有骨环，充满了彪悍之意，目光炯炯的盯着四周，当看到远处跑来的苏铭时，这几个大汉都咧嘴笑了起来。

“拉苏，阿公找了你一天，你怎么才回来。”

“方才下雨，是不是又去抢乌龙涎去了。”

“阿公找我？把绳索扔下来，这次收获还不错。”苏铭快跑几步，来到了那大门下方，得意的拍了拍背后的编篓，大声喊了起来。

随着一根编制的绳索从高处垂下，苏铭一把抓住，身子灵活的攀爬，几个呼吸间就爬上了大门顶端，看到了那几个守夜的族人后笑了笑，顺着一旁的阶梯快走了下去。

“这小娃娃身子灵活，胆子更是不小，多年前就敢独自一人上乌龙山去采药，看来日后部落里的凡医，一定是他了。”

“可惜，他不具备蛮体，否则的话，说不定可以成为阿公一样的蛮医。”几个大汉看着远去的苏铭，微微轻叹。

苏铭进ru到了部落里，一路跑去，四周的草木宅子内，往往有人看到他后，都会善意的喊一声拉苏。

拉苏这个名字，并非是只说他，而是指部落里一切没有到进行第二次蛮启的孩童统称。

不远处，一间部落的兽皮帐外，还有一个五六岁的小女孩，正看着苏铭，稚嫩的小脸上，露出甜美纯真的微笑，她的怀里抱着一只巴掌大小的白色小兽，这小兽看起来很是乖巧温顺，样子仿若白色的绒球。

“拉苏哥哥，你给皮皮抓吃的了么。”那小女孩看到苏铭后，咯咯的笑了起来。

“彤彤，给你。”苏铭哈哈一笑，跑到近前从怀里取出几个浆果，递给了小女孩，在那小女孩开心的笑声中，苏铭来到了部落的中心，看到了大量的族人环绕篝火四周，正在欢声笑语。

篝火外，摆放着一圈耐烧的木栏，上面有许多被烧烤的冒油的大块肉，散发出阵阵香气。

那附近有几个族中少女，看到跑来的苏铭后，都笑着打着招呼，对于这个部落来说，眉清目秀的苏铭，与其他族人有身躯上的差距，几乎每一个族人都要比他魁梧不少，就连这些少女也不例外。

好不容易才挤了出来，抓起一块香气四溢的烤肉，一边咬着，一边向着前方快步跑去。

人群中，正前方的位置，坐着一个唯一穿着不是兽皮，而是粗麻衣衫的老者，这老者头发编着很多小辫，看起来似极为苍老，但双目却是颇有神韵，让人看之一眼，似就要被摄取进去一样。

他身份应是极为尊贵，正低声说着什么，四周有几个族人陪伴，边听边点头，神色极为恭敬。

看到远处跑来的苏铭，这老者脸上露出微笑，点了点头，示意苏铭坐在一旁，又继续和那几个族人交谈起来。

那几个族人同样看到了苏铭，脸上纷纷露出笑容。

“我乌山部虽是小部落，但毕竟是正统的乌山传承，这一次风圳部落蛮公大寿，且我与其当年有一段交情，不能失礼。”那老者缓缓开口。

“可惜数百年前我乌山部落分裂，如今只延续下三脉，否则的话，我乌山部也是中型部落，统领附近八方时，那风圳部也是附属，可眼下……唉。”说话之人，是一个约四旬左右的男子，他是乌山部的族长，其身子魁梧，似充满了惊人的爆发力，脖子上的骨圈赫然有九个手指粗细的牙齿。

尤其是他的脸上，更是有一道若隐若现的纹，那纹的样子极为狰狞，好似鬼神，只不过很是模糊，似始终无法完全凝固。

苏铭看着那纹，眼中露出羡慕，通过那卷兽皮，使得苏铭知道，那是尚未成型的蛮纹，整个部落里，如今没有人具备画下蛮纹使其凝固的实力。

就连阿公，也只是处于凝聚蛮血的第九层而已。

但就算是这样，也使得阿公成为了乌山附近的诸多部落里的极强者，能与之比较的，唯有另外两脉分离而出的往昔同族部落，黑山部与乌龙部。

“过去之事，提之何用，没有开尘境的强者守护，是无法成为中型部落的，当年乌山部的两位开尘境先祖死亡，才是最终分裂的根源所在。

老夫修行至今，始终无法突破这凝血第九层，达不到第十层，更达不到那极限的十一层，无法画下完全凝固的蛮纹，难以开尘……”粗麻衣衫的老者轻叹，缓缓说道。

“罢了，你们下去吧，准备礼物，明日……山痕，你身为乌山猎队魁首，便由你带队启程。”那老者站起身，看来一眼站在那乌山部落族长旁边的一个中年汉子后，转身离开了这里，向着远处走去。

那中年汉子神色平静，听闻此话立刻躬身称是。

苏铭连忙跟在阿公身后，一同离开了这篝火处的繁闹之地。

一路老者没有说话，只是默默地走着，待那身后的欢语也渐渐远去后，他来到了一间草木搭建的屋舍外，走了进去。

这屋舍不大，其内颇为简易，进屋后，这老者盘膝坐在了一旁，看了跟进来的苏铭一眼。

此刻与老者独处，苏铭对这从小看着自己长大的阿公，很是尊敬，将背后的编篓放下，他拿起那小土瓶，递给了老者。

“以你的灵活，那几只乌龙是无法伤你的，不过还是少去为好……那里毕竟也属于黑山部与乌龙部的范围。

这乌龙涎对我无用，你自己留下滋养身体好了。”老者看着苏铭，神色带着慈祥。

苏铭点了点头，将这小瓶收起，这些年来，此物他喝下了很多，也正是因此，才具备了如此灵活的身体。

更是多年来，阿公时常给他熬制一些药汤，使得他尽管不具备修蛮的蛮体，可却也比寻常族人要强上不少。

“还有三天，就是族里你们这代拉苏蛮启的时候了，我记得你也已经到了十六岁……需要去参拜蛮像了。”老者望着苏铭，缓缓说道。

“我乌山部落的蛮像，是传承于当年真正的乌山部，尽管不是主像，还无法与中型部落的蛮像比较，但在附近来说，却是极为强大。”

“这几天不要外出，好好休息一下，三天后和他们一起去蛮启。”老者说着，慢慢闭上了双眼。

苏铭站了半响，拎着编篓默默的离开，走向距离这里不远，那属于他的草木屋舍。

他永远也不会忘记，在七岁那年，他与部落里所有同年龄的孩童一起环绕蛮像，去进行第一次蛮启的情景。

身为蛮族之人，一生需要经历两次如启蒙一般的仪式，这就是蛮启，一次是七岁，一次是十六岁。

同时，部落里的阿公也会在这个时候，借蛮像之力，选择出具备蛮体之人。

轻叹一声，苏铭内心泛起苦涩，他渴望成为修蛮的蛮士，那兽皮卷里的一幕幕描述，让他从小就痴迷，只是现实的残酷，在他七岁那年第一次参拜蛮像时，清晰的显露出，他不具备蛮体，没有修蛮的资格。

蛮，为世界之本，只有成为蛮士，才可以笑傲九天之上，才可以成为真正的强者！

从那兽皮卷上，苏铭小时候就知道，这个世界上有很多部落，大大小小，每一个部落都有各自不同的蛮像，这是一个部落的根本，也是让后代成为蛮的必须之物。

参悟蛮像，若能获得感应，则可自然而然的获得修蛮的传承，不需人教，可自行修炼。

可一旦七岁与十六岁时都失败，则表示一切永远无法被改变，苏铭的内心一直迟疑，没有看到答案时他期待，可如今距离最后一次参悟只有三天，他却害怕起来。

“这一次……能成么……”苏铭默默的回到了自己的屋舍，坐在一旁，发起呆来。

(The new book is urgently needed for collection and recommendation, fellow Taoists,)

This is an ordinary stone fragment, only the size of a baby's palm, irregular in shape. In addition to some seemingly natural veins, there is also a small hollow hole on it, like a pendant.

But overall there is nothing surprising about it, it looks very ordinary.

The only strange thing was that when Su Ming held the fragment, he felt warmth on it, as if a warmth flowed into his body, which made him very comfortable.

"Huh?" Su Ming looked carefully, but after looking for a long time, he couldn't see any clues.

"I heard my grandpa mention it. It is said that this place was once a land of fire barbarians in the early days. From this point of view, this object may have some fire barbarian power, so it makes people feel warm, which is not bad." Su Ming untied the crescent bone ring hanging around his neck, put the fragment in, and hung it again around his neck. The fragment was close to his chest, and the warmth became stronger.

"Go home!" The young man took long strides and ran quickly towards the land of lights in the distance. At this moment, he did not notice that a faint light flashed away from the stone fragments in his arms close to his chest.

As it approached, the weak light gradually became clear in front of Su Ming's eyes, and he could see that it was a tribe surrounded by walls made of many giant trees.

The area was not large, with only a few hundred people living there, but in Su Ming's eyes, this place made him feel warm.Faintly, there were bursts of lively cheers. From the gaps in the rows of giant wooden walls, you could see a huge bonfire in the center of the tribe. There were many tribesmen around it, and some women from the tribe were dancing in front of the bonfire.

The gate of the tribe was also made of giant wood. When it was opened, it was often hung up by a few ropes. Now it was tightly closed. There were several extremely burly men on it, wearing animal skin clothes and extremely rough skin. Strings of white bones hung around their necks, and there were bone rings on their ears, which were full of strength. They stared at the surroundings with bright eyes. When they saw Su Ming running in the distance, these big men all grinned.

"Lasu, grandpa has been looking for you all day, why did you just come back?"

"It just started raining. Have you gone to grab the saliva again?"

"Grandpa, are you looking for me? Throw down the rope. The harvest this time is not bad." Su Ming ran a few steps and came to the bottom of the gate. He patted the basket behind him proudly and shouted loudly.

As a braided rope hung down from a high place, Su Ming grabbed it and climbed nimbly. In a few breaths, he climbed to the top of the gate. He smiled when he saw the clan members who were keeping watch at night, and quickly walked down the stairs on the side.

"This little kid is flexible and very courageous. He dared to go to Wulong Mountain alone to collect medicine many years ago. It seems that he will definitely be the common doctor in the tribe in the future."

"It's a pity that he doesn't have a barbarian body. Otherwise, he might be able to become a barbarian doctor like Grandpa." Several big men looked at Su Ming walking away and sighed slightly.

Su Ming entered the tribe and ran all the way. In the surrounding grassy houses, when people saw him, they would often call out "Lasu" in good faith.

The name Lasu does not refer only to him, but refers to all the children in the tribe who are not ready for the second barbaric initiation.

Not far away, outside a tribe's animal skin tent, there was a little girl of five or six years old. She was looking at Su Ming, with a sweet and innocent smile on her young face. In her arms, she held a palm-sized white beast. This little beast looked very well-behaved and docile, looking like a white pompom.

"Brother Lasu, have you given Pippi something to eat?" The little girl giggled when she saw Su Ming.

"Tongtong, here you go." Su Ming laughed, ran forward, took out a few berries from his arms, and handed them to the little girl. Amidst the little girl's happy laughter, Su Ming came to the center of the tribe and saw a large number of tribesmen surrounding the bonfire, laughing and laughing.

Outside the bonfire, there is a circle of fire-resistant wooden fence, with many large pieces of oily meat being grilled on it, exuding bursts of aroma.

There were several girls from the tribe nearby. When they saw Su Ming running towards him, they all said hello with a smile. For this tribe, Su Ming, who was handsome and handsome, was physically different from other tribesmen. Almost every tribe member was much bigger than him, even these girls were no exception.

After finally squeezing out, he grabbed a piece of fragrant barbecue, bit into it, and hurried forward.

Among the crowd, sitting directly in front of him was an old man who was the only one wearing rough linen clothes instead of animal skins. This old man's hair was braided in many braids and he looked extremely old, but his eyes were quite charming, making people look at him as if they were about to be taken in.

He must be of extremely high status, and he was whispering something. He was surrounded by several tribesmen who were listening and nodding with extremely respectful expressions.

Seeing Su Ming running from a distance, the old man smiled, nodded, motioned for Su Ming to sit aside, and continued talking to the tribesmen.

Those tribesmen also saw Su Ming, with smiles on their faces.

"Although our Wushan tribe is a small tribe, we are the orthodox Wushan tribe after all. This time, the Fengzhen tribe's Barbarian is celebrating his birthday, and I had a relationship with him back then, so I can't be rude." The old man spoke slowly.

"It's a pity that our Wushan tribe split hundreds of years ago, and now only the lower three branches continue. Otherwise, our Wushan tribe is also a medium-sized tribe. When we ruled the surrounding areas, the Fengzhen tribe was also a subsidiary, but now...sigh." The speaker was a man in his forties. He was the leader of the Wushan tribe. His body was burly and seemed to be full of astonishing explosive power. The bone ring on his neck had teeth as thick as nine fingers.

Especially on his face, there is a looming pattern. The appearance of the pattern is extremely ferocious, like a ghost, but it is very blurry and never seems to be completely solidified.

Su Ming looked at the pattern with envy in his eyes. Through the roll of animal skin, Su Ming knew that it was a barbaric pattern that had not yet been formed. No one in the entire tribe had the strength to draw a barbaric pattern and solidify it.

Even grandpa is only at the ninth level of gathering barbaric blood.

But even so, Grandpa has become an extremely powerful person among the many tribes near Wushan. The only ones that can be compared with him are the other two separate tribes of the same tribe in the past, the Black Mountain tribe and the Wulong tribe.

"What is the use of mentioning the past? Without the protection of the strong men of the Kaichen Realm, it is impossible to become a medium-sized tribe. The death of the two Kaichen Realm ancestors of the Wushan tribe was the source of the final split.

So far in my practice, I have been unable to break through the ninth level of blood coagulation, nor can I reach the tenth level, nor can I reach the eleventh level, which is the ultimate limit. I cannot draw completely solidified barbaric lines, and it is difficult to open the dust..." The old man in rough linen clothes sighed softly and said slowly.

"That's all, go down and prepare gifts. Tomorrow...Shan Hen, as the leader of the Wushan hunting team, you will lead the team to set off." The old man stood up, glanced at a middle-aged man standing next to the Wushan tribe leader, turned around and left, walking towards the distance.

The middle-aged man looked calm, and after hearing this, he immediately bowed and said yes.

Su Ming quickly followed his grandfather and left the bustling place near the campfire together.

The old man didn't speak a word all the way, just walked silently. After the happy words behind him gradually faded away, he came to the outside of a house made of grass and trees and walked in.

The house was not big, and the inside was quite simple. After entering the house, the old man sat cross-legged and glanced at Su Ming who followed him.

Now alone with the old man, Su Ming respected his grandfather who had watched him grow up. He put down the basket behind his back, picked up the small earthen bottle, and handed it to the old man.

"With your flexibility, those Oolongs can't hurt you, but it's better to go less often... After all, that place also belongs to the Montenegro Department and the Oolong Department.

This oolong saliva is of no use to me. You can keep it for yourself to nourish your body."The old man looked at Su Ming with a kind expression.

Su Ming nodded and put away the vial. He had drank a lot of this over the years, and it was precisely because of this that he had such a flexible body.

Over the years, grandpa often made some medicinal soup for him, which made him much stronger than ordinary people even though he did not have the barbaric body.

"In three days, it's time for your generation in the clan to raise Su Manqi. I remember that you have reached sixteen years old... and need to pay homage to the Man statue." The old man looked at Su Ming and said slowly.

"The wild statue of my Wushan tribe is inherited from the real Wushan tribe back then. Although it is not the main statue and cannot be compared with the wild statue of the medium-sized tribe, it is extremely powerful in the vicinity."

"Don't go out these days, take a good rest, and go to Manqi with them in three days." The old man said, slowly closing his eyes.

Su Ming stood for a long time, then silently left with the knitting basket, heading towards the grass and wood house that belonged to him not far from here.

He will never forget that when he was seven years old, he and all the children of the same age in the tribe circled the Man statue for the first Man initiation.

As a barbarian, you need to go through two initiation-like rituals in your life. This is the barbarian initiation, once at the age of seven and once at the age of sixteen.

At the same time, the grandfather in the tribe will also use the power of the barbarian image to select people with barbaric bodies at this time.

With a sigh, Su Ming felt bitter in his heart. He longed to become a barbarian who cultivated barbarism. The descriptions of the scenes in the animal skin scroll had made him obsessed since he was a child. However, the cruelty of reality clearly revealed when he first visited the barbarian statue when he was seven years old. He did not have the barbarian body and the qualifications to practice barbarism.

Barbarism is the foundation of the world. Only by becoming a barbarian can one be proud of the nine heavens and become a truly strong man!

From the animal skin scroll, Su Ming knew as a child that there were many tribes in the world, large and small, and each tribe had its own different barbarian statues. This was the foundation of a tribe, and it was also necessary for future generations to become barbarians.

If you can gain induction by understanding the image of the barbarian, you can naturally obtain the inheritance of cultivating the barbarian. You don't need anyone to teach you, you can practice on your own.

But once he fails at the age of seven and sixteen, it means that everything can never be changed. Su Ming has been hesitant in his heart. He looked forward to it when he didn't see the answer. But now that it was only three days before the last enlightenment, he became afraid.

"This time... can it be done..." Su Ming returned to his house silently, sat aside, and stared blankly.
